Explanation:  
The Predicted Answer clearly states that Bill Clinton was president of the United States when Mary Elizabeth Butt, Howard Edward Butt Sr.’s wife, died on October 6, 1993. The Ground Truth Answer confirms that Bill Clinton was president beginning in 1993, which is also the year Mary Elizabeth Butt passed away. The core information—Bill Clinton being president at the time of Mary Elizabeth Butt's death in 1993—is present in both answers. The Predicted Answer even provides the exact date of death, but this does not alter the meaning or factual equivalence relevant to the question.

Decision: TRUE
